summary: Gallery horizontal-scroll fix verified. motion.div now has inline style width: 387.5vw so its layout width (5580px @1440 viewport) equals content width. At scrollYProgress=1, transform=translateX(-74.1936%) => -4139px, which correctly exposes the tail of the track. All 6 cards traverse the viewport during vertical scroll of the wrapper. Item-5 at end: left=340, right=1204 (viewport 1440) — fully visible. Regression: no grayscale filter, no bg-gradient-to-t overlay, backdrop-blur info-chips present (18 chips across 6 items). Mobile 390x844: 6 items rendered vertically (342x428 each). No runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: adding style={{ x, width: `${totalVW}vw` }} makes framer-motion's percent transform work against the true content width. Formula translatePct = -(overflowVW/totalVW)*100 is mathematically consistent with the explicit width — validated numerically (5580 * 0.741936 ≈ 4139px == 5580-1440-1). Consider making TRAILING_VW smaller (e.g. 8-10vw) since the current end state leaves item-5 with right=1204 and ~236px of unused viewport on the right — cosmetic only.
Wrapper height calc wrapperVH = max(240, 120 + count*45) — for 6 items = 390vh ≈ 3510px which yields comfortable scroll pacing; OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery fix from iter14 is validated. motion.div inline style: 'width: 387.5vw; transform: translateX(-74.1936%)' at end. All 6 gallery-item-0..5 pass through viewport correctly. Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 both OK. No page/runtime errors.
rca of the issue: Root cause (found in iter14): percent-based transform on motion.div was applied relative to element's own offsetWidth (which was constrained by the sticky parent to 1440px), so -74.19% translated only ~1068px instead of the needed ~4140px. Fix (iter15): adding inline style width: `${totalVW}vw` (=387.5vw =5580px) makes the flex track's own layout width equal its content width, so -74.1936% * 5580 = -4139px correctly reveals the tail. Verified by inspecting getBoundingClientRect().left/right of gallery-item-5 at scroll end (left=340, right=1204, viewport=1440).
